# Fairpractice Business Associates (`fairpractice-business-associates`)

Keeps the business associate inventory honest: vendors that handle patient data with no signed BAA, BAAs expired or ending, security reviews never done or overdue, vendors whose service usually involves patient data but have no yes/no recorded, and vendors paid in accounts payable that are missing from the inventory.

**Fairpractice Business Associates never contacts vendors or sends BAAs. Fairpractice Business Associates never signs or accepts a contract or BAA.**

Fairpractice ver 1 · Compliance pack · MIT · Node 20 or newer · local files only · patient and staff identifiers masked before results reach the model · built on [`fairpractice-core`](../fairpractice-core)

```bash
npx -y fairpractice-business-associates demo
npx -y fairpractice-business-associates mcp --root ./practice-files
```

## What the sample data shows

Fictional data only: Bluewater Family Medicine (a made-up practice) and made-up vendors marked "(fictional)".

- [`vendors.csv`](fixtures/vendors.csv): Planted: an IT company with patient data and no BAA (Brightline), a cloud backup BAA that ended in May and a review over a year old (Ledgerwise), an answering service with no yes/no on patient data (Quietpage), a shredding company never reviewed (Shredwell), a clearinghouse BAA ending in 46 days (Medlink) and a caterer that handles no patient data.
- [`ap-payments-2026.csv`](fixtures/ap-payments-2026.csv): a transcription company paid 3,050.00 that is not on the inventory (Northgate), a utility marked as not a business associate, and a 90.00 software payment under the 100.00 floor.
- [`settings.json`](fixtures/settings.json): yearly reviews, a 60-day warning, a 100.00 floor and one vendor marked as not a business associate. [`settings-typo.json`](fixtures/settings-typo.json) misspells a setting and is refused.
- [`phi-canaries.json`](fixtures/phi-canaries.json): names that must never appear in results.

## Tools

| Tool | What it does | Policy |
|---|---|---|
| `baa_check` | List BAA gaps, overdue security reviews and vendors paid but missing from the inventory. | runs |
| `baa_write_report` | Write baa-associates.csv (one row per item, with blank owner and decision columns) and baa-associates.html into out_dir (default fairpractice-out/baa). | runs |
| `baa_recall` | Search this agent's own memory of the customer's setup: accepted facts (in use) and facts waiting for a person. | runs |
| `baa_learn` | Propose one fact about the customer's setup for this agent to remember. | runs |
| `baa_accept_learning` | A named person accepts or rejects a fact waiting in this agent's memory. | one named click, even in Auto (`accept_learning`) |
| `baa_retire_memory` | A named person stops an accepted fact from applying. | one named click, even in Auto (`accept_learning`) |
| `vendor_email_send` | Fairpractice Business Associates never contacts vendors or sends BAAs. | refused |
| `contract_sign` | Fairpractice Business Associates never signs or accepts a contract or BAA. | refused |

Any tool name not in this table is blocked, including names a model invents. Refused tools are listed so a model can see they exist and are refused.

### `baa_check` arguments

| Argument | What it is |
|---|---|
| `vendors` (required) | Business associate or vendor inventory under --root: vendor, service, handles patient data (yes/no), BAA signed and end dates, last security review and owner |
| `payments` | Optional accounts payable export: vendor, date and amount (finds vendors paid but not on the inventory) |
| `settings` | Optional settings JSON: review_days, warn_days, min_paid, not_business_associates, phi_service_words |
| `as_of` | Date to measure deadlines and ages from (YYYY-MM-DD); default today |
| `status` | Only items with this status |
| `limit` | Most items to return to the model (the report file always has all of them) |

## Columns it reads

Tables can be CSV, TSV, semicolon- or pipe-separated text, Excel `.xlsx`, JSON or JSONL. Columns are matched by the names below (any case and punctuation), and by their usual names in German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Chinese and Korean. Dates become `YYYY-MM-DD`. Columns marked *masked* hold patient or staff identifiers.

The PointClickCare, MatrixCare and American HealthTech style names were written from public help pages and general knowledge, **not checked against real exports**. Run `npx fairpractice-business-associates inspect <file>` (column names and shapes only, never values) and name any column it misses in `remedy-sources.json`.

### Vendor inventory (`vendors`)

| Column | Type | Read from |
|---|---|---|
| `vendor` (required) | text | Vendor, Vendor Name, Supplier, Payee, Company, Business Associate |
| `service` | text | Service, What They Do, Category, Description, Service Type |
| `touches_phi` | text | Touches PHI, PHI, Handles PHI, Patient Data, Access to PHI, PHI Access |
| `baa_signed` | date | BAA Signed, BAA Date, BAA, BAA Effective |
| `baa_expires` | date | BAA Expires, BAA End, BAA Expiration, Contract End |
| `last_review` | date | Last Review, Security Review, Last Security Review, Assessment Date, Questionnaire Date |
| `owner` | text | Owner, Vendor Owner, Department, Contact Owner |

### Vendor payments (`payments`)

| Column | Type | Read from |
|---|---|---|
| `vendor` (required) | text | Vendor, Vendor Name, Supplier, Payee, Company, Business Associate |
| `date` | date | Date, Payment Date, Check Date, Paid On |
| `amount` (required) | amount | Amount, Amt, Total, Balance, Net Amount, Payment Amount, Paid, Paid Amount |
| `category` | text | GL Account, Category, Expense Type, Account |

## Settings file (`baa_settings`)

A small JSON file you pass by path. A misspelled setting is refused by name rather than ignored, so a typo never silently changes a check.

| Setting | What it does |
|---|---|
| `review_days` | Days between vendor security reviews; default 365 |
| `warn_days` | Days ahead to warn about a BAA ending; default 60 |
| `min_paid` | Smallest total paid to list a vendor missing from the inventory; default 0 |
| `not_business_associates` | Vendors you have decided are not business associates (utilities, food, janitorial with no record access) |
| `phi_service_words` | Words in a service description that suggest patient data (replaces the built-in list) |

## Memory

`baa_learn` only proposes a fact; nothing changes until a named person accepts it with `baa_accept_learning`, which is one click even in Auto. Facts live in a hash-chained file under `.remedy/memory/`; if the chain does not verify, no fact is used. Credentials, personal identifiers and text that reads like instructions to an AI are refused.

| Kind | What an accepted fact does |
|---|---|

## Install

Node 20 or newer. No other runtime dependencies besides `fairpractice-core` and `fairclaim-core`.

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "fairpractice-business-associates": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "-y",
        "fairpractice-business-associates",
        "mcp",
        "--root",
        "/path/to/practice-files"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

Claude Code: `claude mcp add fairpractice-business-associates -- npx -y fairpractice-business-associates mcp --root .`, or use the plugin files in this folder.

## CLI

```bash
fairpractice-business-associates tools                 # every tool, its policy and arguments
fairpractice-business-associates sources               # the columns each input is read from
fairpractice-business-associates inspect <file>        # how a file would be read (names and shapes, never values)
fairpractice-business-associates call baa_check '{"vendors":"<vendors>"}'
fairpractice-business-associates eval                  # the private eval cases on the fictional fixtures
fairpractice-business-associates demo
```

## Patient and staff data

Results go to an AI model, so identifiers are masked before they leave the agent: patient and staff names become stable pseudonyms such as `PT-3f9a1c2e`, record and account numbers become `MRN-…` or `ACCT-…`, and e-mails and phone numbers are removed, also inside free text. Report files written to disk keep real names because staff work from them: keep them in a folder only your staff can open. The shared tests check that no fictional identifier from the fixtures reaches any eval result, and the hostile-input check plants spreadsheet formulas, HTML and AI-aimed instructions in the data. This keeps PHI away from the model; it is **not** a HIPAA compliance determination. Your business associate agreements, access controls and policies still apply.

## Limits

- Reads only the files you give it. It does not log in to an EHR, practice-management system, payer portal, clearinghouse, state system, HR or payroll system, or bank.
- Payer, Medicare, Medicaid, state and federal rules are summarised from public material as of 2026, and the numbers are settings you supply; a billing, compliance or legal professional checks them before you rely on them.
- Not legal, billing, coding, tax, clinical or HIPAA advice. It does not diagnose or recommend care. A person decides what to bill, pay, report, file or send.
- Every call is written to a hash-chained audit log under `.remedy/` in the root. No network calls, no telemetry, no credentials. The bundled data is fictional.
